name: general_req_pci_op_c

name: general_req_fru_hook
note: needs three words and a brick type in the list 5 @ O B F L M $ , } . { (else -101); passes the first two arguments to the routine at 0xffe809ec with a null record and sends status 0, or -106 when its result is negative, then that result as an integer; what the routine does for each selector was not read
